_meta.description: Conditions ledger (contract B, optional). One row per condition a legislator states for supporting or opposing a bill. Extracted by extract-conditions.mjs; demand registry consolidated deterministically.

demands.name: Narrow bill to SSN verification only
Assess DOE staffing capacity before adding work
Adopt amendments resolving NFA and excise tax issues

conditions.condition: Provide more clarity limiting the Secretary's discretion to open widespread investigations and unspecified oversight activities before codifying the expanded review process.

conditions.bill: H.J. Res. 139
conditions.condition: Support only if the amendment also requires ending billionaire giveaways, curbing presidential corruption and profiteering, and requiring ICE to comply with the Constitution.
conditions.quote: I will only support a constitutional amendment compelling Republicans to finally balance a budget if it also compels them to stop throwing money at billionaires, to crack down on record corruption and profit-taking by their incorrigible President

conditions.condition: Support on the floor depends on significant revision to add enforcement guardrails, evidence of Department success under current practices, and wider consultation with higher education stakeholders.
conditions.quote: We urge the House of Representatives to oppose H.R. 7892 unless there is a significant revision, evidence provided of Departmental success of current practices, and wider consultation of higher education stakeholders.

conditions.condition: Sort out concerns about weakening the National Firearms Act and the excise tax or adopt the amendments offered to address them.
conditions.quote: Unless we can sort this out, or unless some of the amendments that are being offered today are adopted, I'm going to have to be a ``no'' and urge the rest of the committee to be a ``no'' on this.
